title: A blank Logo answer keeps the template's logo on every CMS (Joomla T3 and T4, JA Essence WP, Tracy Business WP)
steps: S1: Run node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/brief-brand.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-brand-joomla.test.mjs from the repository root.
S2: The tests run the brand engine with a blank Logo answer (and with a logo id that cannot be read) against site doubles of each template and read what was written.
expect: S1: every named test reports ok.
S2: no logo, dark logo, style logo or footer logo slot is written; the name and monogram still change where the template has them.
evidence: Before the fix a blank Logo answer took the name-as-text branch of the WordPress, Joomla T3 and T4 writers, replacing the template's logo (LOGO-4 dropped 09/10/2026, commit 9d669828a, #1013).
fence: The brand engines writing a logo only when the customer gave one that could be read.

tests: a blank Logo answer on JA Essence WP keeps the demo logo and dark logo (no name as text)
a blank Logo answer on Tracy Business WP keeps the identity logo; the name and monogram still change
a logo id that could not be read keeps the template logo too
a blank Logo answer on T3 keeps every style logo as released
a blank Logo answer on T4 keeps every logo key and the footer slot as released
